thread:
nina: Brain dump  idea for autoscale policy: combine per-tenant soft-quota + priority-affine burst credits. Want quick sanity check before drafting RFC.

raj: sketch it out pls. What's soft-quota exactly?

nina: soft-quota = guaranteed reservation but can be exceeded using burst credits; excess trimmed first from lower priority tenants. We avoid hard denies unless pool is exhausted.

claire: sounds good. how do credits accumulate & decay?

nina: credits accrue proportional to idle time up to cap. decay is exponential slowdown when high-burn observed across shard. config knobs: accrual_rate, cap, decay_threshold.

raj: admission path? atomic reserve across k GPUs?

nina: runtime flow: controller asks runtime -> runtime attempts atomic lock of k slots -> if steady available admit; else check credits (tenant & priority) -> if enough, tentatively reserve and return admit + used_credits metadata. Controller commits on start.

claire: edge: multi-shard jobs. If tenant has credits on shard A but not B, we might block. Plan?

nina: preference: prefer local shard. Fallback: cross-shard borrow only when global-reconciler enabled. Keep local-only for initial rollout.

raj: observability? want to quickly debug production issues.

nina: metrics: tenant_credit_level, credit_accrual_rate, tentative_reservations, cross_shard_borrows, eviction_count_by_priority. Tag by tenant, shard, priority.

claire: rollout plan?

nina: FF off by default. Enable for internal tenants->small canary group->monitor 72h -> ramp to more tenants. Auto-off rule if shard evictions or 99p latency regresses beyond threshold.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: burst-credit-softquota -> canary (build #4984) :rocket:

raj: one more thought: add a tiny immutable slack (2-5%) per shard that is never borrowable so we avoid tail-correlated thrash.

nina: agree, will add shard_slack_pct to schema. I'll draft RFC with schema, admission API sample, metrics, and kill-switch. Thanks for quick checks.

claire: yes pls include sample config and a diagram for the admit flow.

nina: will do, pinging when draft is up.
